quests.title: Rock Tunnel: Regirock, Regice and Registeel (League HQ investigation)

acquisitions.conditions: During League HQ’s first investigation round, defeat Goh and the Rocket group in Rock Tunnel. Read the memorial with Wailord in party slot 1 and Relicanth in slot 6. Answer Yes, No, Yes, then “Be ready to fight”. Accept each statue’s gift with a free party slot.
